params.body:
The partner API page is served publicly at `/docs/partner`. It named the package behind the token route and listed which partners use the API, with call frequencies and a repository path.

- The token paragraph now says what `POST /api/token` does (refresh an OAuth token with the client id and secret from Stocklist, fifteen days valid), and that a token on a user's password cannot be requested, without naming the package or the grant switch.
- "Wie gebruikt deze API" is replaced by "Wagens tonen op een website": a builder who only shows cars uses the public API or the embed.

Docs only. `DocsPagesTest` and `DocsMatchRoutesTest` pass; the endpoint table is unchanged.

Closes #1134
params.title: Partner API page: no library name and no partner list on a public page
